sources.name: Arm Architecture Machine-Readable Specification (open JSON release)
sources.license: Arm MRS open release (permissive; see package notice)

conventions.structural_only: encoding-and-operand data only; narrative semantics (ASL pseudocode), flag effects, and prose descriptions are not in the permissive source and are linked out to the Arm manual via doc_url.
conventions.bit_numbering: encoding.fields use lo/hi inclusive bit indices; bit 0 is the least-significant bit of the instruction word.
conventions.doc_url: per-instruction deep link to the Arm A-profile ISA manual (A64 -> DDI0602, A32/T32 -> DDI0597).

coverage.note: AArch64 A64 plus AArch32 A32/T32, from the Arm MRS open JSON.
coverage.semantics_from: Structural only (encodings, operands, feature gates). Pseudocode/flags/prose are not in the permissive release; each instruction links to the Arm manual for full semantics.
